join hortbot 999 foobar 1
join hortbot 999 otherchan 2

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command adda pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command clone #foobar pan
send hortbot #foobar [HB] A command or list with name 'pan' already exists.


handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Usage: !command clone #<channel> <name>

handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone #foobar
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Usage: !command clone #<channel> <name>

handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone foobar pan
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Usage: !command clone #<channel> <name>

handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone #foobar pan
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Command 'pan' has been cloned from channel foobar.

handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!pan working command
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command restrict pan
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Command 'pan' is restricted to everyone and above.


handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone #foobar huh
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Channel foobar does not have a command named 'huh'.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!list add something
send_any

handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone #foobar something
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] 'something' is not a command.


handle hortbot otherchan/2 otherchan/2 :!command clone #who something
send hortbot #otherchan [HB] Channel who does not exist.
